title: Join me for more soft, real food wins
summary: They think it’s brownies… I know it’s calm fuel. Soft, chocolatey, and secretly packed with fiber and protein ...the kind of snack that makes snack time peaceful for both toddlers and moms.
caption: 💌 Join me for more soft, real food wins 💛 They think it’s brownies… 🍫  I know it’s calm fuel. 🌿 Soft, chocolatey, and secretly packed with fiber and protein ...the kind of snack that makes snack time peaceful for both toddlers and moms. ☁️💛 Ingredients: Mold: 12×18 cm ¾ cup (150 g) cooked lentils, well drained 1 cup (200 g) steamed sweet potato  1 egg ¼ cup (30 g) unsweetened cocoa ¼ cup (40 g) spelt flour 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup or honey Steps: 1. Preheat oven to 180 °C / 350 °F. 2. Blend all ingredients until smooth. 3. Pour into a greased mold. 4. Bake 20–23 min, center should remain slightly soft. 5. Let cool completely before cutting. Result: Soft, fudgy texture with gentle chocolate taste, rich in fiber and plant-based protein. --- #ToddlerSnacks #HealthyBaking #RealFoodForKids #SoftChocolateBrownies #MomLife
